how to become a completely
different person in 90 days

pick one keystone habit

choose one habit that makes others easier, like sleeping at the same time every night. one strong habit pulls the rest along without you forcing everything at once.

change your mornings

the first hour decides the rest of the day. spend it outside, moving or reading instead of on your phone, and the next 90 days will look completely different.

learn a little daily

spend 5 minutes a day learning something outside your comfort zone: art, science, history. ninety small lessons later, you think and talk like a different person.
slides.texte_sophia:
learn a little daily

i spent 5 minutes a day learning something outside my comfort zone: art, science, history. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and 90 lessons later i think differently.

slides.texte_overlay:
edit your feed

unfollow every account that makes you feel worse. what you see every day shapes who you become, and after 90 days of a better feed you'll barely recognise your thoughts.

track it on paper

mark every day you keep your habits on a paper calendar. seeing ninety small marks build up is more motivating than any quote, poster or speech ever could be.
